name: markdown-plain-link-replacer
description: Replace plain links in markdown with titled links, looking up each page's title: http://example.com becomes "[Example Domain](http://example.com)", *example.com*, or any template you give. Library and command line tool; TypeScript, ESM and CommonJS, Node 20+.
author: Mark Rogers (https://www.markdavidrogers.com)

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:dist
scripts.test:dist: node --test test/golden/golden.test.js test/unit/find-links.test.js test/unit/template.test.js test/unit/source.test.js test/unit/arguments.test.js test/functional/replace-plain-links.test.js test/cli/cli.test.js test/package/shape.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --check-coverage --lines 95 --branches 90 --exclude-after-remap --include "src/**" --reporter text --reporter lcov node --test test/golden/golden.test.js test/unit/find-links.test.js test/unit/template.test.js test/unit/source.test.js test/unit/arguments.test.js test/functional/replace-plain-links.test.js test/cli/cli.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm test
